title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat (soprano)
text: Row, row, row your boat, gently down the stream. Merrily, merrily, merrily, merrily, life is but a dream.
speaker: VocalSet (Wilkins et al., ISMIR 2018), CC BY 4.0, singer f7

metrics.vocoder: g_arch1 fine-tuned for singing (vera_demo L2 arm sing, step 1011600: VocalSet 18 singers + LibriTTS, f7/m5 held out; native sung f0)
metrics.music_note: synthesised piano-like accompaniment in C major (the singer's key: tonic = the opening "row"s and the closing "dream"), chord strikes on the sung word onsets; I, V7 on "life is but a", I on "dream"; tuned to the singer (+15 cents); -30 LUFS (voice -20)

pipeline: sung audio -> HuPER CTC alignment of the known lyrics (phones + whole-frame boundaries) + SPARC f0/loudness/speaker -> SPK stage-2 gesture codes (the codec encoder) + y38 GLO/VEL -> frozen v5 body (feedback off) -> 12-ch positions -> vocoder with the sung f0
note: Melody (f0) is passed through unquantised; the 52-byte speech packets quantise pitch, which would put a song off key.
